name: A Few Days
source:
You are a private detective, who scored the easiest case in the world. All you have to do is sit in
a sleepy town and wait.

On your first day of what you believe is doing nothing and getting paid for it, you get roped into doing a little bit of private detecting for someone, which should only take a few days.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你是一名私家侦探，接到了世上最轻松的案子。你只需要待在一座宁静的小镇里，等待就好。

第一天，你本以为可以什么都不做就把钱挣了，却被拉去替某个人做一点侦探工作。应该只需要几天。

[摘自F95Zone]
